dialogues.speaker: Tosalis
dialogues.text: Ah... I was once language itself. Now, I am reduced to a shattered subject of illusion, returning once more to this imperfect "symbol."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eek! A weirdo saying weird things just popped out of a weird book!

dialogues.speaker: Tosalis
dialogues.text: "Weird" is an imprecise term. It implies a unique entity that cannot be described, written, or characterized. I clearly do not fit that definition.

dialogues.speaker: Tosalis
dialogues.text: I was merely attempting to find an entry point to "reality" within these pages, only to slip into an inadvertent, infinite deferral of metaphors...

dialogues.speaker: Tosalis
dialogues.text: I have become a remainder that defies symbolization. It is thanks to your intervention that the tyranny of language has been stripped from me. Now, I can finally begin to misrecognize myself once more...

dialogues.speaker: Tosalis
dialogues.text: ...I accidentally tumbled into the pages and got stuck. Thank you for pulling me out.
